teaser: Floods + barge attacks cut Bor off from Juba
title: Floods cut the Juba–Bor road as attacks halt Nile barges
body: Flash floods have submerged the Juba–Bor highway near Mangalla and trucks are turning back. Armed men attacked a barge convoy north of Juba overnight, and river convoys between Juba and Bor are suspended until further notice. Forecasters expect more rain over Jonglei in the next 48 hours, which could make the Bor–Pibor track impassable.

title: Checkpoints close the Rumbek–Leer road amid tensions
body: Local authorities closed checkpoints on the Rumbek–Leer road after clashes between communities near Leer. Transporters report the road is closed to trucks until further notice.

teaser: Clashes isolate Nasir on the Sobat
title: Clashes near Nasir halt Sobat river convoys
body: Fighting broke out around Nasir town on the Sobat river. River convoys between Malakal and Nasir are suspended. The Ulang–Nasir road is closed to trucks.

teaser: Tanker fire blocks the Juba–Bor road
title: Fuel tanker overturns and blocks the Juba–Bor road
body: A fuel tanker overturned and caught fire on the Juba–Bor road near Mangalla, blocking both lanes. Police say the road will stay closed for at least two days.
